provenance.authoring_note: The candidate pool was prepared in the generation pass. A separate source-bound verification pass examined each candidate lemma, POS, one-sense gloss, semantic boundary, relation decision, and any ambiguous particle span before shared axis-coverage selection.

review.method: Candidate-by-candidate semantic verification against the bound lemma, POS, writer-facing gloss, sense boundary, and relation evidence, with authored grammatical evidence for ambiguous particle spans, followed by shared proportional axis selection.
criteria: per-unit record type and part of speech
independent fit between lexical identity and authored writer-facing gloss
single writer-facing sense scope and unsupported cause or disjunctive gloss checks
authored evidence for ambiguous particle spans
shared lexical quality rules as corroborating evidence, not semantic verdicts
review.admission_rule: admit selected included or corrected rows only; preserve held and rejected outcomes as non-imported decisions, while the shared selector derives fit reserve rows separately

selection.selection_rationale: The shared selector allocates the 1,000-start target proportionally across source-bound axes after semantic eligibility. Verification rank breaks ties within each axis and does not determine eligibility.
